summary: Verified rotated ANTHROPIC_API_KEY works end-to-end. All 6 pytest checks passed in the first full run: .env sanity, llm.py preference order, anonymous pronounce (source=none), authenticated pronounce (source=llm with non-empty IPA), caption-search spelling correction (Charlstn->Charleston), and backend log verification showing api.anthropic.com HTTP/1.1 200 OK with no Anthropic authentication_error and no Emergent fallback usage.

llm.py correctly prefers ANTHROPIC_API_KEY over EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; no changes needed.
test_credentials: Magic-link via Mongo lookup for katherine@katherinebeck.com (admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_anthropic_key_rotation.py is idempotent EXCEPT the auth fixture consumes a magic-link token. Magic-link requests are limited to 5/email/hour. If re-running quickly, either wait or reuse an unconsumed token from Mongo. First run verified: authenticated /api/pronounce?word=Vrelthanor returned source='llm' with valid IPA; /api/caption-search?q=Charlstn returned corrected_query='Charleston'. Backend logs show fresh api.anthropic.com 200 OK responses timestamped 2026-09-14 during test window.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug. Rotated key is fully operational.
